/.title: Websites, apps and custom software
/.description: Welqor designs and builds websites, mobile apps, custom software and AI tools. Fixed quotes, milestone demos, and code you own.

/about.title: About
/about.description: Welqor is a software studio in Coimbatore building websites, apps, custom software and AI tools. Founded by Kavinkumar B and Kavinkumar P, who work on every project.

/services.title: Services
/services.description: Websites, web apps, mobile apps, custom software, UI and UX design, AI and automation, and cloud. Seven services, one team, one fixed-quote process.

/industries.title: Industries
/industries.description: What Welqor builds for healthcare, retail, education, finance, logistics, manufacturing, hospitality, real estate and professional services, and what we watch for in each.

/solutions.title: Solutions
/solutions.description: Start from the problem, not the feature list. Find the one that sounds like yours and see what we would build for it.

/technologies.title: Technologies
/technologies.description: The tools Welqor builds with: React, Next.js, Flutter, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, LLM APIs and the major clouds, and why we pick each.

/work.title: Work with us
/work.description: Three ways to work with Welqor: a fixed-scope project, a dedicated team, or a care plan for a live site or app. Find the one that fits.

/work/project.title: Fixed-scope projects
/work/project.description: A fixed price agreed up front, paid in milestones, with a working build to review at every milestone and a week-by-week timeline in your proposal.

/work/team.title: Dedicated teams
/work/team.description: A dedicated Welqor team on your roadmap, billed monthly per person. You set the priorities; the same people stay on your product.

/work/care.title: Care plans
/work/care.description: Monthly care for live sites and apps: security updates, bug fixes, tested backups, uptime alerts, small improvements and a plain-language report.

/faq.title: FAQs
/faq.description: Answers on pricing, timelines, process, ownership, support and working with Welqor.

/support.title: Support Centre
/support.description: Report a problem with a site or app Welqor looks after. See our hours, response times and what to include so we can fix it fast.

/contact.title: Connect with Welqor
/contact.description: Book a free 30-minute call, message us on WhatsApp, or write to us. One of the founders replies within one working day.

/terms.title: Terms & Conditions
/terms.description: The terms that apply when you use the Welqor website or work with Welqor.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy.description: What information Welqor collects through this website, how it is used and stored, and the choices you have.
